svg.title: Sairithik Komuravelly
svg.desc: Sairithik, in dot-matrix letters that change to Sai and then to heysai.dev. Fast with AI. Fluent without it. Products, AI tooling, AI workflows. A diagram shows one ticket fanning out to five research agents, merging, going through a three-agent debate and a review gate that sends it back once, then reaching a human.
